ShaderNodePreset.Description: Turns a clip into a jumbotron/LED-wall look - resolves the image into individual glowing RGB (or mono) sub-diode dots with black gaps and bloom, matching a real LED video wall close-up.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: MM_Jumbo

Uniform.Name: front
Uniform.Tooltip: The clip to turn into a jumbotron/LED-wall look.

Uniform.Name: PixelSize
Uniform.Tooltip: Size of each LED macro-pixel cell, as a proportion of frame height - bigger for a chunkier, closer-up look, smaller for a finer wall seen from further away

Uniform.Name: DotSize
Uniform.Tooltip: Size of each individual glowing diode dot relative to its cell - higher fills more of the cell, leaving a thinner black gap between diodes

Uniform.Name: DotSoftness
Uniform.Tooltip: Edge softness of each dot's hard core - 0 for a crisp diode edge, 1 for a very soft blob

Uniform.Name: GridAngle
Uniform.Tooltip: Rotates the LED grid - useful if the camera was slightly off-axis to the physical wall

Uniform.Name: BloomRadius
Uniform.Tooltip: How far each diode's glow spreads beyond its own hard core

Uniform.Name: BloomAmount
Uniform.Tooltip: Strength of the glow bleeding out from each diode - the key to the diodes reading as genuinely glowing light sources rather than flat coloured dots

Uniform.Name: Brightness
Uniform.Tooltip: Overall diode brightness - LED walls typically read brighter/punchier than the source footage

Uniform.Name: BlackLevel
Uniform.Tooltip: Baseline dark grey shown in the gaps between diodes, instead of pure black

Uniform.Name: Variation
Uniform.Tooltip: Subtle random per-cell brightness variation, like the slight non-uniformity real LED panels show up close

Uniform.Name: SatAmount
Uniform.Tooltip: Pushes colour saturation up (or down) - LED walls tend to read more vivid than the source content
Master on/off - off passes the clip through unprocessed, for A/B comparison
Uniform.Name: JumboOn

Uniform.Tooltip: Off: three individual R/G/B sub-diodes per cell (the true subpixel look). On: a single tinted dot per cell driven by luminance, matching a plain single-colour LED wall
Uniform.Name: MonoMode

Uniform.Tooltip: Overlay thin black seams dividing the wall into physical panel modules, each built from a block of LED cells
Uniform.Name: PanelGridOn
PanelSize
Uniform.Tooltip: Number of LED cells across each physical panel module

Uniform.Name: PanelLineWidth
Uniform.Tooltip: Thickness of the black seam between panel modules, as a proportion of frame height

Uniform.Name: PanelLineOpacity
Uniform.Tooltip: Darkness of the panel seams - 1 for solid black joins, lower to soften them

Uniform.Name: TintColorR
Uniform.Tooltip: Mono Mode diode colour - red

Uniform.Name: TintColorG
Uniform.Tooltip: Mono Mode diode colour - green

Uniform.Name: TintColorB
Uniform.Tooltip: Mono Mode diode colour - blue
